high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft, warm hues in the sky. The sky is filled with a mix of clouds, some of which are illuminated by the light, creating a gradient of colors from deep purples and blues at the top to lighter pinks and oranges near the horizon. The clouds are scattered, adding texture and depth to the sky. The ocean below is relatively calm, with gentle waves rolling towards the shore. The water has a muted brownish tone, reflecting the subdued lighting conditions.
